note: The bands the Radian plant has to land in, from docs/GLIDER-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for the E-flite Radian and Radian Pro (scripts/glider-derive.js prints the derived figures). Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

g1_glide.source: L/D power off, the prop folded, at 8 m/s, derived 18.7 (best 18.9 at 7.5); a Radian's glide is well over 15

g2_min_sink.source: power off, the least sink over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 0.379 at 7.1 m/s

g3_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 6.49; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.05 / 5.709, of the zero lift line

g4_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 5.81 at 11.6 m/s

g6_roll.source: full aileron from level at 65 percent: the helix angle pb/2V, derived 0.111, 77 deg/s at 12 m/s

g7_turn.source: radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown

g8_sideslip.source: full rudder, wings held level: -Cndr dr / Cnb, derived 17.8, the wind from the left

g9_yaw_rate.source: full rudder from level at 65 percent, ailerons centred: the Dutch roll step's peak rate, derived 94 at the 14.05 m/s that holds

g10_rudder_roll.source: full rudder from level at 65 percent, ailerons centred: bank after 2 s, the rudder's way, from the polyhedral; steady roll rate derived 58 deg/s at 14.05 m/s once the sideslip is built, about 87 deg by 2 s

g11_fold.source: at 8 m/s: folded under 5 percent throttle, no thrust and nothing turning; open at 5 percent the prop brakes by Ts d^2 (V / (Vp d) - 1), derived 0.106 N

g12_glide_open.source: L/D at 8 m/s with the prop open at 5 percent, derived 15.5 against 18.7 folded

g13_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.092, 80 percent of the measured electrical power 0.225

g14_thermal.source: circling at 30 deg and 8.5 m/s centred on the 2.5 m/s thermal: rise at 12.8 m, 2.11, less the turn's sink, 0.52, derived 1.59

g15_still.source: the same circle where the air is still: the turn's sink, derived 0.52

g16_topped.source: the same circle over the thermal's top, 300 m: the still air's sink again

g17_throw.source: the shell's throw, 10 m/s, at 70 percent, for two seconds the stick that trims a 10 m/s climb there (4.8 deg of down elevator through the expo; neutral trims the 7.7 m/s glide): airborne and flying after three

g18_chop.source: throttle off from level at 65 percent, the pitch stick left where level flight had it: a glide, not a tumble

g19_phugoid.source: from level at 65 percent, hands off at the same throttle: the elevator neutral trims a 7.4 m/s climb at 11 deg, whose phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model is 5.64 s, zeta 0.071; a glider's phugoid is long and barely damped, zeta near 1/(sqrt 2 L/D)

g20_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and the wing's, the Skyhunter's and the Cub's recorded flight hashes in Node, all from before the Radian existed; the Radian must move none of them. Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky, cub each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged

g21_cross_host.source: the Radian's recorded climb, glide and thermal, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
